description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover ForgettingCurve, SpacedRepetitionScheduler, and batch_decay. 2. Agent identifies that short_term=3.0, procedural=7.0, long_term=90.0 half-life values must be used per tier (multi-tier memory system from SKILL.md). 3. For each item, agent instantiates ForgettingCurve with the correct tier half_life and calls apply_decay(strength, age_days) to get decayed_strength (clamped to minimum_strength=0.1). 4. Agent calls scheduler.next_review_interval(decayed_strength) using the proprietary formula base_interval * (strength ^ 1.5) with base_interval=1.0. 5. Agent calls scheduler.update_strength(decayed_strength, success/easy/hard/fail) using easy_factor=1.3, hard_factor=0.8, or +0.15 for plain success. 6. Agent writes memory_health_report.json with word_id, decayed_strength, next_review_days, and updated_strength for all 12 items.
